pattern: SVG box plot as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "box plot") of role="img" boxes with roving focus; data table fallback (native table with every statistic and the outlier values).

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized "box plot"), named by the title
img with an aria-label: category, series, five-number summary, outlier count
list (ul) named "Legend"; entries are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: axes, whiskers, median lines, outlier dots, textures, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id

Localized "{category}, {series}: median {median}, quartiles {q1} to {q3}, whiskers {min} to {max}", followed by ", {n} outlier(s)" when there are outliers (for example "EU, Prod: median 14, quartiles 12 to 16, whiskers 10 to 16, 1 outlier")
0 on exactly one box (roving); other boxes have none
true while the series is visible
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Previous / next category in the same series (mirrored in RTL); categories without a box are skipped.

keyboard.context: Box focused, more than one visible series
keyboard.action: Same category in the previous / next visible series (nearest box when missing).
First / last box of the series.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Legend buttons, then one tab stop for the plot (the active box), then the Show data table button and table region.
Shows or hides the series (native button).

focus: Roving focus: one box is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited box (series id and category), also across re-renders (resize, update). Toggling a legend entry keeps focus on its button; toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: Each box name reads the five-number summary (median, quartiles, whisker ends) and the outlier count.
Outliers are decorative dots; their values are listed in the Outliers column of the data table.
The generated summary lists the series and category counts, each series' lowest and highest median with their categories, and hidden series.
Meaning never depends on color alone: textures on the boxes of the second and later series (patterns option), plus legend keys that repeat them.
Box outlines are drawn in the series color (3:1 against surfaces); the median line uses the text color.
Forced colors: medians CanvasText, outlier dots Canvas-filled; focus and hover use Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
Individual outliers are not focusable; their values are available in the data table only.
